tagline: Private by design. No accounts. No tracking. No digital noise.
description: IDEMO is a premium, privacy-first Belgrade concierge app created for international visitors during EXPO 2027. It offers carefully curated recommendations, personalized Vibe Match suggestions, offline-friendly planning, and a calm, elegant way to discover Belgrade beyond generic tourist lists.
shortDescription: A premium, privacy-first Belgrade concierge for EXPO 2027 visitors.
usp: Hyper-curated Belgrade experiences matched to each visitor’s style, without registration, tracking, or interface noise.
positioning: A boutique cultural-concierge platform and soft-power showcase for modern Belgrade.
notAffiliatedDisclaimer: IDEMO is an independent travel concierge and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to EXPO 2027 organizers.
